name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)
description: Design resilient, high-performing, secure, and cost-optimized architectures on AWS.

questions.text: A company needs durable object storage for static website assets that must be served to users worldwide with low latency. Which combination of AWS services is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 provides 11 nines of durability for object storage and integrates natively with CloudFront, a global CDN that caches content at edge locations to reduce latency for worldwide users.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Amazon EBS with an Application Load Balancer

choices.label: C
choices.text: Amazon EFS with AWS Global Accelerator

questions.text: Which AWS service should be used to decouple a web tier from a batch-processing worker tier so that messages are not lost if a worker is unavailable?
questions.explanation: Amazon SQS is a fully managed message queue that decouples components. Messages persist in the queue until a worker successfully processes and deletes them, preventing loss when workers are down.

questions.text: Which TWO actions improve the availability of an Amazon RDS database?
questions.explanation: Enabling Multi-AZ provisions a synchronous standby in another Availability Zone for automatic failover. Read replicas offload read traffic and can be promoted, both increasing availability.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create one or more read replicas

choices.label: C
choices.text: Switch the instance to a burstable T-class type

choices.label: E
choices.text: Store the database password in plaintext user data

questions.text: An application running on EC2 needs to access an S3 bucket. What is the AWS best-practice way to grant this access?
questions.explanation: Attaching an IAM role to the EC2 instance provides temporary, automatically rotated credentials. Hardcoding access keys is discouraged because they are long-lived and easily leaked.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Embed IAM user access keys in the application code

choices.label: B
choices.text: Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instance

choices.label: C
choices.text: Store root account credentials in environment variables

questions.text: Which storage class is most cost-effective for data that is accessed once or twice a year and must be retrievable within 12 hours?
questions.explanation: S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost class, designed for long-term retention with retrieval times of up to 12 hours, matching rare-access archival needs.

questions.text: A solutions architect must allow an Auto Scaling group to scale based on the number of messages waiting in an SQS queue. Which metric should drive the scaling policy?
questions.explanation: A target tracking policy on a backlog-per-instance metric derived from ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible scales the group with the queue depth.

questions.text: Which service provides a managed NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond latency and automatic scaling?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed key-value and document NoSQL database delivering consistent single-digit millisecond performance with on-demand or auto scaling.

questions.text: To meet a requirement that data in transit between an on-premises data center and a VPC must not traverse the public internet, which connection should be used?
questions.explanation: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection from on-premises to AWS, keeping traffic off the public internet for consistent latency and security.

questions.text: Which TWO design choices help optimize cost for a fault-tolerant batch workload that can tolerate interruptions?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances offer up to 90% savings for interruptible workloads. Right-sizing instances avoids paying for unused capacity. Reserved Instances suit steady-state, not interruptible batch.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Right-size the instance types to the workload

choices.label: C
choices.text: Run everything on the largest available instance

choices.label: E
choices.text: Use On-Demand for all capacity permanently

questions.text: A company wants to run containers without managing the underlying EC2 instances. Which service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers that removes the need to provision and manage EC2 instances for ECS or EKS workloads.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Amazon EC2 with a launch template
